profile_transformation: Existing normalized V1 fields are projected into the V3 equipment-renewal profile; SME density and credit access remain deterministic proxy formulas.
persona_transformation: Six documented axes are converted to inclusive 0-1 percentile ranks using average ranks for ties; type and constraints follow the frozen PRD priority rules.
missing_value_handling: Generation fails when a required profile field, province, or network source is missing.
quality_policy: Persona quality is proxy unless its source profile is demo; personas are never marked verified.
